attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "This reverts the async options configuration to synchronous (using GetAwaiter().GetResult() on blob container creation), which reintroduces potential deadlocks/blocking calls during tenant startup and changes DI patterns (BlobOptions to IOptions<BlobOptions>) that could break any custom code depending on the newer async setup, though it restores previously working behavior."}

reason: This reverts the async options configuration to synchronous (using GetAwaiter().GetResult() on blob container creation), which reintroduces potential deadlocks/blocking calls during tenant startup and changes DI patterns (BlobOptions to IOptions<BlobOptions>) that could break any custom code depending on the newer async setup, though it restores previously working behavior.
